recordings.rmk:
Possible American x Northwestern Crow intergrade given the geographic location.
 Immature/Juvenile individual.
12 degrees Celsius.
Rainwater dripping from the trees after raining heavily the day before and at night.
Adults in the trees nearby and a Common Raven roosting close to the immature individual. 
In the trees close to a creek that is choked with Western Skunk Cabbage and Marsh Marigold.

recordings.rmk:
Close to Mendenhall River, Salmon are in.
Small short-bodied crow with small slender bill and short legs and feet.
Individual recorded was very close. Foraging with a flock of thirty. Many subadults, a few juveniles.
All very loud and vocal. Staying close together. All appeared healthy. Foraging in a field of mown grass.
Possible American x Northwestern Crow intergrade.
